title: Subscription Billing Cycles & Invoicing Terms
content: All enterprise plans are billed on Net-30 terms upon receipt of invoice. Annual commitments receive a 15% discount. Payment methods accepted include ACH bank transfer, corporate credit card, and wire transfer. Invoices can be downloaded anytime via Billing Settings.

title: Refund Policy and Disputed Charges
content: Refund requests within 14 days of subscription renewal are eligible for a prorated refund if service utilization is under 5%. Refunds exceeding $100 require financial controller approval and will be processed within 5-7 business days. Disputed card charges should be submitted to billing@nexusflow.ai before filing a chargeback.

title: REST API Authentication & Rate Limits
content: API requests must provide a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Rate limits are set to 120 requests/minute on standard endpoints and 30 requests/minute on bulk batch endpoints. When rate limited, endpoints return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header indicating cooldown seconds.

title: Webhook Retries and Idempotency Keys
content: All incoming webhooks should include an Idempotency-Key header. If an external service does not respond with HTTP 200 within 5 seconds, NEXUS Flow automatically retries with exponential backoff (attempt 1: 5s, attempt 2: 30s, attempt 3: 5m, attempt 4: 1h).

title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) & Credential Resets
content: Users locked out due to lost 2FA tokens can request a reset using their emergency recovery codes. If recovery codes are unavailable, an identity verification procedure must be conducted with the organization's Primary Workspace Admin. Automated passwords or 2FA overrides are prohibited.

title: P1 Production Outage Protocol & SLA Guarantees
content: P1 Critical incidents are defined as total service unavailability affecting more than 20% of users. Guaranteed incident response SLA is under 15 minutes. Incident status is broadcast live at status.nexusflow.ai and dedicated incident commanders are assigned via Slack #incident-response.
